value.rationale: The complete anti-forcing classification of all 33 perfect matchings of the canonical 16-vertex cubic symmetric, non-distance-transitive Möbius–Kantor graph isolates a distinguished three-matching orbit by complementary 2-factor type. Explicit matching of deletion and alternating-cycle packing optima demonstrates a minimax equality in this nonplanar bipartite case, a natural finite stability benchmark beyond the planar theorem; no arbitrary parameter slice is selected.
